notes.title: Love Shore Patch Updates
notes.notes:
Howdy folks! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38755349/b0fdbff3bf60534be4c1316700738c9a3e4924b8.png[/img]

We've released a new patch for Love Shore to include a bunch of quality of life features (and fix a bug with the steam achievements!) 

💜Fixed errors with achievements
😈Included a “remove UI button”
💜Included a text log of previous text until that moment
😈Included quick access to the manual save via a menu
💜Separated quick save and previous save slots more clearly (with colors!)
😈Added a delete option to save slots

Thank you all for playing Love Shore! We have been listening and constantly aiming to improve as we move forward! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38755349/32b6c2a787c0db34f4ee5be01a12bdcf1df2b1d8.png[/img]

notes.title: New Love Shore Demo!
notes.notes:
Howdy Citizens of Love Shore!

Thank you so much with your patience! We've been preparing for a sim-ship, aiming for a new release date of Spring 2023! Specifics will be shared soon, but in the meantime...

[b]We have a new demo![/b]

That's right! With our further delay, we wanted to share something to show we've been actively progressing and improving! Introducing our new demo! 

We hope you enjoy it and thanks for your patience! And also...

Welcome to Love Shore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38755349/363d1ec1ae99b99ecc40609d2827b28f0b2a9045.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Perfect Garbage & #FutureOfPlay Direct
notes.notes:
Perfect Garbage is proud to present a new perspective on Love Shore at #FutureOfPlay!

It's an event you don't want to miss, filled with amazing indie showcases, but most importantly: a new secret project from us!
